entities.summary: Muene "Mamissa" Tshijuka is a Congolese basketball player. She competed in the women's tournament at the 1996 Summer Olympics. The third of four children, she grew up playing handball in school until a coach recommended she try basketball. She committed to play college basketball for Old Dominion in 1998, transferring to Nebraska–Kearney in 2000.
